A triathlon race consists of three parts:
•
a 1500 m swim
•
a 40 km bike ride
•
a 10 km run.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
John swims the 1500 m in 25 minutes.
Find his average speed, in km/h, for this swim.

parts.text:

Find the average speed, in km/h, for John to complete his 10 km run.
